# Inflation curve (`inflation-curve` v1)

Zero-coupon breakevens by tenor, with monthly seasonality.

**Group:** Market data · **Mnemonic:** `INFC` · **Identifiers:** `INFC-…` in `curveId`

Open one with `INFC <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: inflation-curve
version: 1
description: "Zero-coupon breakevens by tenor, with monthly seasonality."
match: { kind: inflation-curve, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Market data · Inflation curve, id: $.curveId }
strip:
  - { label: Index, bind: $.index }
  - { label: "5Y breakeven", bind: $.be5y, fmt: pct2, emphasis: true }
  - { label: "10Y breakeven", bind: $.be10y, fmt: pct2 }
panels:
  - id: curve
    kind: line
    title: ZC breakevens (%)
    key: F2
    rows: $.points
    x: tenor
    y: breakeven
    fmt: price2
  - id: seasonality
    kind: hbar
    title: Seasonality
    area: right
    rows: $.seasonality
    label: month
    value: factor
    fmt: price2
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.inflationIndex, 'inflation-index')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
